items.text: Add GateDecisionChallenge as a new Category A (Notarized) entry type in mishpat integrity DNA (challenge_id CID, challenged_decision_cid, challenger_id, grounds, summary, evidence_refs, filed_at, reach)
ChallengeGrounds enum: factual-error | safety | policy | constitutional | indemnification-request, mapped to existing mishpat CHALLENGE_GROUNDS where overlap exists

Standing/challenge-rights validation: subject always; stewards over content-type; affected community members; protocol stewards on constitutional/safety; dangling challenged_decision_cid fails integrity validation
Challenge Reach gate: private-steward/community/public/protocol; escalate-only during review (cannot narrow)
Tiered review: app-steward (default) / qahal community / existential-boundary, severity-determined; reuse Discussion + Proposal/ProposalVote mishpat types
Add ChallengeOutcome as a second Category A (Notarized) mishpat entry type (verdict, reviewer_consensus, ConstitutionalReasoning reused, decided_at, indemnification_action co-committed)
ChallengeVerdict enum: upheld | dismissed | superseded; upheld REQUIRES Some(indemnification_action)
IndemnificationAction enum: ReputationDegrade / SubstanceAttestation / ReparationAttestation / ConstitutionalUpdate (non-exclusive, multiple per outcome)

Five-step upheld loop: outcome commits, GateDecisionAttestation stays immutable (additive link only), SubstanceAttestation on ElohimSubstance CID, ReparationAttestation to affected party, degraded-trust signal feeds future invocations
Reputation accumulation: observed from the outcome graph; dimensions (total/challenged/upheld/dismissed/severity_weighted/time_decay/substance_continuity); filter to phase: elohim-active
Substance-continuity policy: constitutional-descendant transfers reputation; full substance rotation resets by policy; rotation is notarized imagodei record (legible not erasure)
Reputation feeds trust-modulated inspection depth + peer-dispatch preference via elohim-strength vocabulary (appeals-sustained positive; upheld-challenge negative)
Coordinator zome fns mishpat::create_gate_decision_challenge and mishpat::create_challenge_outcome
Link types connecting GateDecisionAttestation -> ChallengeOutcome (pattern of IdToGateDecision/ElohimToGateDecisions) + elohim-storage projection tables for both new entry types
HTTP routes for filing challenges and querying challenge status
